_comment: Effect lines for the 31 rider-audit rows (6 from db/vr-rider-audit.json, 25 from db/vr-rider-audit-onaxis.json). A line is written only from the act's own stored title, short title and summary, the text those audits quoted and saved in their `measures` snapshots, and is stored once in consistency.js _DOS_EFFECT under the block marked RIDER ROWS (v320). A row whose text states no effect on its leaf is left blank, with the reason. No score, weight, mapping, primary flag or shipped line is touched.

rows.auditPhrase: boosting defense and immigration enforcement
rows.line: Boosted immigration enforcement in full-year FY2025 funding that trimmed some domestic spending; the House passed it 217-213.

rows.auditPhrase: exempting homeless individuals, veterans and former foster youth
rows.line: Exempted homeless individuals from the SNAP work rule as it raised the age limit to 54; the House cleared it 314-117, the Senate 63-36.

rows.auditPhrase: exempting homeless individuals, veterans and former foster youth
rows.line: Exempted veterans from the SNAP work requirement as it raised the age limit to 54; the House cleared it 314-117, the Senate 63-36.

rows.auditPhrase: expanded Affordable Care Act premium tax credits
rows.term: Affordable Care Act premium tax credits
rows.line: Expanded Affordable Care Act premium tax credits; the House cleared it 220-211, the Senate 50-49.

rows.auditPhrase: repeals statutory provisions on diversity, equity and inclusion within the Department
rows.line: Would have repealed DoD provisions on diversity, equity and inclusion, including the Chief Diversity Officer; the Senate passed it 77-20.

rows.auditPhrase: the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to report certain information to the Department of Justice
rows.line: Barred funds for Veterans Affairs to report certain information to NICS for background checks; the Senate agreed to it 53-45.

rows.auditPhrase: emissions mandates on farm equipment that drives up expenses for farmers
rows.line: Would remove farm-equipment emissions mandates to ease expenses for farmers and consumers; the House agreed to it 215-213.

rows.auditPhrase: the critical factual material they rely on in rulemaking
rows.line: Would require agencies to publish the critical factual material they rely on in rulemaking; the House passed it 362-1.

rows.auditPhrase: require mandatory cash bail for certain offenses
rows.line: Would require mandatory cash bail in the District for certain offenses that threaten public safety; the House passed it 237-179.

rows.auditPhrase: during national defense-related operations
rows.line: Proposed exempting military personnel from Endangered Species Act bans in national defense operations; the House rejected it 200-228.

rows.auditPhrase: digital asset sales
rows.line: Nullified IRS broker tax reporting on decentralized-finance digital asset sales; the House cleared it 292-132, the Senate 70-28.

rows.auditPhrase: sets discretionary spending caps for FY2024 and FY2025
rows.line: Set discretionary spending caps for FY2024 and FY2025, enforced by sequestration; the House cleared it 314-117, the Senate 63-36.

rows.auditPhrase: suspends the debt limit through January 1, 2025
rows.line: Suspended the debt limit through January 1, 2025; the House cleared it 314-117, the Senate 63-36.

rows.auditPhrase: emergency rental and homeowner assistance
rows.line: Funded emergency rental and homeowner assistance; the House cleared it 220-211, the Senate 50-49.

rows.auditPhrase: an expanded child tax credit
rows.line: Expanded the child tax credit; the House cleared it 220-211, the Senate 50-49.

rows.auditPhrase: guidance on Medicaid telehealth and school-based Medicaid services
rows.line: Directed guidance on Medicaid telehealth and school-based Medicaid services; the House cleared it 234-193, the Senate 65-33.

rows.auditPhrase: a market-structure framework for digital assets
rows.line: Would set a market-structure framework for digital assets, splitting oversight between the CFTC and the SEC; the House passed it 294-134.

rows.line: Proposed taking DACA renewal funds from the bill’s $69.545 billion for border and immigration enforcement; the Senate rejected it 47-52.
